premises.text: Cross-border remittances suffer lost funds, delays, high cost, and low transparency
premises.evidence_span: Lost funds, delayed delivery of funds, high cost, low transparency

premises.text: SendMe integrates with employer payroll so employees can send payroll funds cross-border, top up phones, and pay international bills
premises.evidence_span: integrates with an employer's payroll system and allows employees to send payroll funds cross-border, top up mobile phones, and pay international bills

premises.text: FDIC-insured wallet receives a portion of each paycheck for sending abroad
premises.evidence_span: that balance is held at a financial institution and is FDIC-insured

premises.text: Direct Central Bank of Mexico connection enables instant transfers to Mexican bank accounts
premises.evidence_span: We have built a direct connection to the Central Bank of Mexico, which allows us to do an instant transfer to Mexican bank accounts

premises.text: Recipients can also cash out via a large BBVA ATM network with a code
premises.evidence_span: We can also send funds to a network of over 10,000 BBVA ATMs in Mexico

premises.text: Banking-network interoperability is created through central-bank and partner connections
premises.evidence_span: We're creating that interoperability by building partnerships

premises.text: Combining payroll with money services shifts behavior, cuts regulatory and CAC costs, and can shift paying to employers
premises.evidence_span: We combine payroll with money service business, and in so doing, shift user behavior, reduce regulatory costs, and reduce customer acquisition costs

premises.text: Distributed through banks, payroll providers, and employers; beachhead is US–Mexico corridor
premises.evidence_span: We distribute the products to banks, payroll providers, and direct to employers

premises.text: Low upfront fees and FX with value-added services drive international transfer cost toward zero
premises.evidence_span: We charge between $1 and $4 up front and 2% in foreign exchange

value.text: High-transparency, lower-cost, more efficient cross-border payroll transfers
value.evidence_span: a solution that is high transparency, lower cost

secondary_value.text: More money reaches recipients when transfer costs fall
secondary_value.evidence_span: With each 1% reduction in the cost of international transfers, $6 billion goes into the hands of recipients

causal_links.evidence_span: We've experienced every problem imaginable as it relates to sending money
allows employees to send payroll funds cross-border
driving the cost of the international transfer to zero

notes: Pain list folded as one remittance problem set. Phone top-up and bill pay kept inside payroll flex-pay offer (P2) as same product surface; ATM cash-out and central-bank rail split as distinct delivery modules. Price and partner distribution: fee model (P9) kept with commercial package; bank/payroll distribution (P8) separate channel module.
